note: CKEditor5 Line Height ships one CKEditor 5 plugin (id ckeditor5_line_height_line_height) that adds a 'lineHeight' toolbar item. It has no settings route (configure=null), no permissions, no services, no Drush. Its only persistent state is per-text-format editor config: editor.editor.<format> -> settings.toolbar.items[] must contain 'lineHeight', and settings.plugins.ckeditor5_line_height_line_height.line_height_options holds the space-separated value list (default 0 0.5 1 1.5 2 2.5 3 3.5 4 4.5 5 5.5 6 6.5; values >= 10 are dropped on save). Medium/hard cases build real CKEditor 5 text formats (clh_*) and read/verify the toolbar item and option list from the editor config entity. The set-options verify reads RAW config because Editor::getSettings() prunes plugin settings equal to the plugin defaults.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site, how do I give editors a Line Height control in CKEditor 5 using the ckeditor5_line_height module? Name the toolbar button/item and where I add it.
evals.expected_output: Edit a text format that uses the CKEditor 5 editor at /admin/config/content/formats, and drag the 'Line Height' button (toolbar item id 'lineHeight') into the active toolbar. There is no separate settings page.

evals.prompt: Where does the ckeditor5_line_height module store the list of selectable line-height values for a text format, and what is the default list?
evals.expected_output: In the editor config entity editor.editor.<format> under settings.plugins.ckeditor5_line_height_line_height.line_height_options (a sequence of strings). Default: 0 0.5 1 1.5 2 2.5 3 3.5 4 4.5 5 5.5 6 6.5.

evals.prompt: If I type line-height options into the ckeditor5_line_height settings and include a value of 10 or higher, what happens when I save? And what happens if I leave the field empty?
evals.expected_output: validateConfigurationForm() removes any value >= 10 and de-duplicates the list; an empty field resets the options to the module defaults.

evals.prompt: This site has a CKEditor 5 text format 'clh_known' with the Line Height button enabled. Inspect the live editor configuration and list the exact line-height options configured for it.

Two CKEditor 5 text formats on this site are named clh_active and clh_plain. Exactly one has the ckeditor5_line_height 'Line Height' button in its toolbar. Inspect the live editor config and state which format has it.
evals.expected_output: clh_active has 'lineHeight' in settings.toolbar.items; clh_plain does not.

evals.prompt: This site has a CKEditor 5 text format 'clh_task' that does not yet expose line-height. Using the ckeditor5_line_height module, add the Line Height button to that format's CKEditor 5 toolbar and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: editor.editor.clh_task settings.toolbar.items contains 'lineHeight' (e.g. add it via the format's CKEditor 5 toolbar builder or by editing the editor entity settings).

evals.prompt: The CKEditor 5 text format 'clh_opts' already has the Line Height button but offers the full default list of values. Reconfigure the ckeditor5_line_height plugin on that format so it offers exactly three line-height options: 1, 1.5 and 2. Apply the change to the live site.
